mentions.name: Lily
mentions.description: A CLI tool installable into any coding agent via a hook that grants read-only access to production systems by wrapping ssh, kubectl, awscli, gcloud, and az, letting agents investigate production issues safely without risking changes.
mentions.problem: Figuring out production issues takes a lot of time during initial investigations, and letting agents loose in production risks breakage unless someone babysits them or relies on prompts to keep them safe.
mentions.audience: The author and their team during initial investigations of production issues
mentions.source_excerpt: [Lily](https://github.com/aspectrr/lily) A CLI tool that can be installed to any coding agent via hook that gives read-only access to production systems (wraps ssh, kubectl, awscli, gcloud, az) so agents can investigate issues in production.
